lessons.title: Practice Function Tool Definitions for LLMs
lessons.description: Tool definitions let LLMs trigger local functions. The OpenAI function-calling guide defines a tool as JSON with "type": "function", "name", "description", and a JSON-schema "parameters" object ("type": "object", "properties", "required"). Implement get_sql_query_tool_spec() returning exactly that structure for a read-only SQL tool: name 'run_sql_query', description 'Run a read-only SQL query against database', one string property 'query' described as 'SQL query to execute', required ['query']. Tests check type, name, parameters.properties.query.type and parameters.required.

tests.name: test_tool_spec
tests.unittest_code:
def test_tool_spec(self):
    spec = get_sql_query_tool_spec()
    self.assertEqual(spec['type'], 'function')
    self.assertEqual(spec['name'], 'run_sql_query')
    self.assertEqual(spec['parameters']['properties']['query']['type'], 'string')
    self.assertEqual(spec['parameters']['required'], ['query'])
